//: Not a workspace package (pnpm-workspace.yaml globs apps/* and packages/*, not apps/desktop/e2e). This manifest exists ONLY to declare the module format of the Playwright E2E graph. Playwright decides per file whether to emit ESM or CommonJS from the nearest package.json `type` (transform/esmLoader.js: `isRequire ? 'commonjs' : fileIsModule(filename) ? 'module' : 'commonjs'`). apps/desktop has no `type`, so without this file every spec is CommonJS, and every ESM-only workspace library it reaches (@brainstrike/utils, @brainstrike/logging, @brainstrike/file-system — all `type: module` since BST-1014) is force-transpiled to CommonJS. That breaks three ways: `import.meta` cannot be represented in CommonJS; `export *` becomes a runtime getter loop that cjs-module-lexer cannot see through, so static named imports of re-exported bindings fail to link; and a CommonJS-transpiled escaping target cannot safely require an ESM-only package. Keeping the E2E graph ESM matches how those libraries actually ship. NOTE the boundary is not uniformly ESM: a runtime relative import that escapes this directory lands under apps/desktop's manifest, which is still CommonJS, so Playwright transpiles that module even though its importer is ESM. Today the only such crossing is ../../src/desktop-renderer-config, an import-free resolver leaf; any new crossing must stay free of bare runtime dependencies, `export *` and `import.meta`. See BST-1217.
